2995.title: Production build changes files used by a live runtime
2995.rootCauseOneLine: The package build deletes and copies directories that an active checkout runtime uses for later child processes.
2995.proposedFix: Refuse the package build before its first write when a live bb process has a command path inside the same repository root.
2995.caveats: The fix needs a packaging policy choice, so this run did not create a pull request.
